guidance.sentence: • Raising FY26 revenue guidance to $844-$852 million which represents reported revenue growth of 14.5% - 15.5%

Total reported revenue guidance reflects a neutral impact from foreign currency and an approximately 2.5 point tailwind from inorganic growth primarily from the BioLife acquisition net of the divestiture of Polymem .

summary: Repligen raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $844-$852 million (14.5%-15.5% reported growth), including BioLife Solutions from its October 6, 2026 closing, with a neutral FX impact and an approximately 2.5 point inorganic tailwind.
